title: Can a US war against Venezuela be avoided?
description: THE Philippine media has completely ignored the story, but the international media and other organs of public opinion have raised the alarm about a possible war breaking out between the United States and Venezuela over the control of Venezuelan oil. Can it be avoided? Or, is it too late to stop it? If a war breaks out, it won’t be the first time that nations have risked mutual destruction because of this commodity called oil.

title: Trump says U.S. struck dock on shore where he says alleged drug boats 'load up'
description: U.S. President Donald Trump has indicated that the United States has "hit" a dock facility along a shore as he wages a pressure campaign on Venezuela, but offered few details.

title: U.S. Coast Guard chases Venezuelan oil tanker attempting to claim Russian protection
description: The U.S. Coast Guard is still in pursuit of an oil tanker over a week after they first tried to intercept the ship. U.S. officials said the tanker now has a painted Russian flag on its side in an attempt to draw protection from Moscow. This is the latest in President Trump's pressure campaign on Venezuela after he indicted that the United States has "hit" a dock facility along a shore.

title: ‘There was a major explosion’ - Trump says US hit area where boats ‘loaded’ drugs in Venezuela
description: US president Donald Trump said yesterday the United States had “hit” an area in Venezuela where boats are loaded with drugs, which would mark the first known time the United States has carried out operations on land in Venezuela since a pressure campaign began against the government of Nicolas Maduro.

title: Trump Says US Hit Docking Area For Alleged Venezuela Drug Boats
description: Donald Trump said Monday the United States had hit and destroyed a docking area for alleged Venezuela drug-running boats -- in what could amount to the first land strike of the military campaign to counter narcotics trafficking from Latin America.
